canonicalization_rules: Select deterministic payload fields: id, query, generated_claim, citation, expected_status, authoritative_passage_id, evidence_passage, verification_tier, difficulty, source, source_dataset, case_type, mutation_type, mutation_details, expected_behavior, explanation
Sort dictionary keys alphabetically recursively using json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
Encode normalized UTF-8 string into bytes
Compute hashlib.sha256(bytes).hexdigest() as lowercase hexadecimal string
Assign resulting 64-character string to content_hash field
